name: U.S. Department of Energy SBIR/STTR (Office of Technology Commercialization)
program: DOE SBIR/STTR Phase I and II releases (reauthorized April 2026)
collect_note: Reads the DOE SBIR/STTR Application Hub (ConnectWerx, the DOE partnership intermediary that runs every OTC release) as a WordPress list of solicitations twice a day, so each new Phase I or Phase II release becomes a dated call row; the old Office of Science SBIR page lists no open calls and the energy.gov pages have no machine-readable list. Each release covers many DOE topics, so rows wait for review (auto_vet false) to judge whether a topic fits agrivoltaics.
evidence: GET sbir-sttr.connectwerx.org/wp-json/wp/v2/avada_portfolio HTTP 200 application/json (checked 2026-11-12): 3 solicitations (FY26 Fall deadline 12/16/2026, Genesis Mission 09/10/2026, FY25 Phase II 10/02/2026). Dead channels: /feed/ holds only a WordPress Hello World post; Grants.gov search2 has no DOE OTC SBIR releases (only ARPA-E ones); science.osti.gov/sbir says all Office of Science funding opportunities are closed and points to OTC; energy.gov/technologycommercialization SBIR page is a prose page with no list.
